FRAME-BODY this frame carries more text than the chrome the outer page drops, which is the condition under which the loss disappeared: the text that came back was measured against the outer body alone, the frame's contribution pushed the total past it, and the subtraction clamped to zero. The paragraph is deliberately long so that the arithmetic cannot come out right by accident, and so that a reader of the result can see the difference between what the page renders and what was handed back. Nothing here is chrome, nothing here is hidden, and every character of it is counted on both sides of the comparison.
